# Brian Dominguez, audiobook narrator

Brian Dominguez narrates audiobooks for independent authors. Since 2025 he has recorded fourteen titles for Audible, from espionage thrillers and science fiction to practical guides on money, business and relationships.

He voiced all four books of Tobey Alvarez's espionage series The Disavowed, so listeners hear one voice from the first book to the latest.

He also wrote Sam on the Way, letters from a father-to-be to his unborn son over the nine months before the birth. It first came out as a paperback in 2008, and Brian recorded the audiobook himself in 2026.

## Audiobooks narrated by Brian Dominguez

- [The Disavowed: Project Null](https://briandominguezvoice.com/audiobooks/the-disavowed-project-null/index.md): by Tobey Alvarez; espionage thriller, book 4 of The Disavowed; 3 hr 16 min; released October 10, 2026
- [The Disavowed: Project Vanguard](https://briandominguezvoice.com/audiobooks/the-disavowed-project-vanguard/index.md): by Tobey Alvarez; espionage thriller, book 3 of The Disavowed; 2 hr 59 min; released August 10, 2026

# The Disavowed: Project Null

- Written by: Tobey Alvarez
- Narrated by: Brian Dominguez
- Genre: Espionage thriller
- Series: The Disavowed, book 4
- Length: 3 hr 16 min
- Released: October 10, 2026
- Publisher: Tobey Alvarez
- Language: English, unabridged
- Listen: [Audible](https://www.audible.com/pd/B0HMM5Z5QZ), [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?i=audible&k=The+Disavowed%3A+Project+Null+Brian+Dominguez)
- Sample: https://samples.audible.com/bk/acx0/536881/bk_acx0_536881_sample.mp3

## About the book

Six months after the Collapse, the world is quiet—but not at peace.

The networks have gone dark. The systems have fallen. And the people left behind are learning the hard way that silence doesn’t mean safety.

Former operative Elena Rojas wanted out—until fragments of her own voice start surfacing across the ruins, used to justify a new global regime rising from the ashes. Now she’s pulled back into a war she thought she buried, facing a truth she can’t ignore: the Collapse didn’t end the machine—it evolved it.

With Lucía Serrano, Omar Rafiq, Darius Cole, and D.C. Carter, Rojas wages a final war against The Breach—a rogue coalition built on the bones of the old Directorate, led by the cold, calculating Dr. Mara Vance.

From Lisbon’s dead grids to the jungles of South America, Project NULL is a brutal fight for what remains of human agency in a world addicted to control.

When every system falls, the only thing left to protect is the truth. Gripping, cinematic, and unapologetically real, Project NULL closes the Disavowed trilogy with fire, betrayal, and hard-won redemption—where survival means rewriting the rules that broke humanity in the first place.

For fans of: Taylor Sheridan, Greg Rucka, Children of Men, and Body of Lies.

Summary from the publisher.

# The Disavowed: Project Vanguard

- Written by: Tobey Alvarez
- Narrated by: Brian Dominguez
- Genre: Espionage thriller
- Series: The Disavowed, book 3
- Length: 2 hr 59 min
- Released: August 10, 2026
- Publisher: Tobey Alvarez
- Language: English, unabridged
- Listen: [Audible](https://www.audible.com/pd/B0HDQ2551C), [Apple Books](https://books.apple.com/us/audiobook/the-disavowed-project-vanguard-unabridged/id6800102374), [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?i=audible&k=The+Disavowed%3A+Project+Vanguard+Brian+Dominguez)
- Sample: https://samples.audible.com/bk/acx0/524963/bk_acx0_524963_sample.mp3

## About the book

After the fall of the Tribunal, the Ninth Division is scattered and disavowed.

Lucía Serrano leads what’s left of her team—D.C. Carter, Omar Rafiq, and Anya Kovács—through the shadows of a collapsing intelligence world. When a series of covert “stabilization leaks” points to a new black-budget program called Project Vanguard, they uncover the man behind it: Admiral Victor Kaelen, a war hero turned architect of psychological warfare.

Vanguard isn’t propaganda.

It’s control through fatigue—a global system that weaponizes misinformation until truth itself burns out.

Drawn back into the fire are former agents, fugitives, and ghosts from the Division’s past—and among them, a hunted Spanish analyst named Elena Rojas, whose leaked draft of the Vanguard Directive made her the world’s most wanted woman. Joined by cynical ex-Interpol operative Noah Keene, Lucía’s fractured team races across Europe to stop Kaelen’s silent war before it erases the very concept of accountability.

From the ruins of Geneva to the rooftops of a dying digital world, Project Vanguard dives into the war for perception itself—where data becomes doctrine, and heroes are rewritten in real time.

They can’t save the world.

They can only make lying expensive again.

A gritty, high-intensity geopolitical thriller blending espionage realism with psychological warfare and modern disinformation.

Fans of Jason Bourne, Body of Lies, and Deus Ex: Human Revolution will find the same fusion of intelligence intrigue and moral collapse.

Summary from the publisher.

- Released: July 2, 2026

- Sample: https://samples.audible.com/bk/acx0/518520/bk_acx0_518520_sample.mp3

## About the book

Financial Freedom After Divorce: The 90-Day Checklist to Rebuild Your Finances and Regain Control

Divorce reshapes every part of your life, especially your finances. Managing bills, accounts, and budgets alone can feel overwhelming, and fear of missed payments and late fees adds stress.

Financial Freedom After Divorce is a 90-day guide to eliminate chaos and build a solid financial foundation. Unlike generic budgeting apps, it offers a clear, structured plan to get organized, avoid costly mistakes, and take control of your money.

Inside, you’ll discover:

- A 90-day checklist breaking essential tasks into manageable steps
- Strategies to avoid missed payments and protect your credit
- A simple framework for bill management and account tracking
- Actionable tools and real-life scenarios for every stage of rebuilding
- Cheatsheets including a payment tracker, budget planner, and quick-reference guide

Practical and backed by research, this guide helps you create lasting habits, prevent setbacks, and gain independence and confidence.

Why this book works:

- Designed for newly divorced professionals
- Time-bound 90-day structure ensures progress without overwhelm
- Focuses on practical action, not abstract advice
- Helps you make smart decisions today that protect your future

Each step fits into a busy lifestyle, proving you don’t need endless time or energy to get your finances back on track—just the right system.

By the end of 90 days, you’ll have a reliable plan, peace of mind, and confidence in your financial future.

Step into your new life with confidence—Financial Freedom After Divorce shows you the way.

Summary from the publisher.

# What's So Special About Rome?

*A Solva Publishing Travel Guide*

- Written by: Barnaby Sorrens
- Narrated by: Brian Dominguez
- Genre: Travel
- Length: 2 hr 32 min
- Released: June 18, 2026
- Publisher: Solva Publishing
- Language: English, unabridged
- Listen: [Audible](https://www.audible.com/pd/B0H5RL95NL), [Apple Books](https://books.apple.com/us/audiobook/whats-so-special-about-rome-a-solva-publishing/id6781720859), [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H5RGFYTB)
- Sample: https://samples.audible.com/bk/acx0/516445/bk_acx0_516445_sample.mp3

## About the book

Rome is not a city that can be understood quickly, and it is certainly not one that reveals itself fully through its most famous landmarks alone. It is a place built upon layers of time, meaning, and human activity, where the past does not sit quietly behind glass or within museum walls, but remains actively present in the streets, the buildings, and the rhythm of daily life. To encounter Rome is to engage with a city that exists across centuries at once, where ancient foundations support modern movement, and where every corner carries a sense of continuity that few other cities can match.

At first glance, Rome appears defined by its most recognisable symbols. The Colosseum stands as a powerful reminder of imperial ambition, the Pantheon demonstrates the technical and artistic sophistication of ancient engineering, and St Peter’s Basilica rises as a symbol of spiritual authority and architectural grandeur. These structures are instantly recognisable, not only within Italy but across the world, forming part of a shared cultural understanding of what Rome represents. Yet these landmarks, however impressive, are only fragments of a much larger story. They offer entry points, but they do not provide the full picture. The true nature of Rome lies in the connections between these elements, in the spaces between them, and in the ways they are woven into everyday life.

Summary from the publisher.

# The Disavowed: The Ninth Division

- Written by: Tobey Alvarez

- Length: 4 hr 12 min
- Released: January 27, 2026

- Sample: https://samples.audible.com/bk/acx0/492665/bk_acx0_492665_sample.mp3

## About the book

Eight operatives.

One mission no one will claim.

And a truth powerful enough to bring governments to their knees.

When a nameless file surfaces across global intelligence networks—a dossier marked only with a red 9—eight agents from eight nations are quietly assembled under a false flag operation. Their orders: investigate the leak, neutralize whoever caused it, and erase all traces of involvement. Officially, The Ninth Division doesn’t exist.

But once the team discovers that the Division isn’t just a black-budget task force—it’s a cover for a vast, state-sanctioned network moving weapons and people under the guise of aid—the hunters become the hunted. Cut off from command, burned by their own governments, and outnumbered on every continent, they must decide whether to stay silent… or set the truth free.

As the mission unravels into betrayal, survival, and revelation, only three will make it out alive.

And the files they unleash will ignite a global reckoning no one can control.

Perfect for listeners who love:

- Global conspiracy thrillers grounded in realism
- Complex characters caught between duty and survival
- The raw tension of Jason Bourne, Jack Ryan, and Body of Lies
- Gritty, atmospheric prose and moral consequences

In a world built on deniability, truth is the most dangerous weapon of all.

The Ninth Division is the explosive first entry in Tobey Alvarez’s hard-edged espionage saga—where the lines between hero and traitor blur, and every mission leaves blood on the paper trail.

Summary from the publisher.

# Reverse Psychology

*The Art of Influence and Indirect Persuasion*

- Written by: James Rietz
- Narrated by: Brian Dominguez
- Genre: Psychology
- Length: 1 hr 45 min
- Released: November 3, 2025
- Publisher: James A Rietz
- Language: English, unabridged
- Listen: [Audible](https://www.audible.com/pd/B0FZD6NP24), [Apple Books](https://books.apple.com/us/audiobook/reverse-psychology-the-art-of-influence/id1850564237), [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FZCZSV92)
- Sample: https://samples.audible.com/bk/acx0/478480/bk_acx0_478480_sample.mp3

## About the book

Master the subtle science of getting people to do what you want—by telling them not to.

Ever told someone not to do something and watched them do it immediately? That’s no accident—it’s reverse psychology in action. Whether you’re a parent facing a stubborn toddler, a teacher trying to motivate students, or just someone who’s tired of hearing “no,” this book reveals how to flip the script with science-backed persuasion.

Inside, you’ll discover:

- What reverse psychology really is (and what it isn’t)
- How psychological reactance explains our urge to rebel
- When it works best—by age, personality, and setting
- How to use it at home, work, and even in marketing
- The warning signs of when it backfires—and how to avoid them

With real-world examples, light humor, and expert insight, Reverse Psychology is your step-by-step guide to smarter influence. Learn how to persuade without pressure and make people want to choose your side—while thinking it was their idea all along.

Summary from the publisher.

# Understanding the Circular Economy

*Strategies for a Sustainable Future*

- Written by: Clement Pereira
- Narrated by: Brian Dominguez
- Genre: Business
- Length: 1 hr 44 min
- Released: June 9, 2025
- Publisher: Clement Pereira
- Language: English, unabridged
- Listen: [Audible](https://www.audible.com/pd/B0FC7SFB4K), [Apple Books](https://books.apple.com/us/audiobook/understanding-the-circular-economy-strategies-for/id1819514429), [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FC83GKZX)
- Sample: https://samples.audible.com/bk/acx0/453018/bk_acx0_453018_sample.mp3

## About the book

This audiobook provides a comprehensive exploration of the circular economy, a sustainable alternative to the traditional linear economic model. Listeners will learn key principles, strategies, and innovations driving circularity across industries. Through case studies, practical applications, and expert insights, learners will gain actionable knowledge on waste reduction, resource recovery, sustainable design, business models, and policy frameworks.

Learning Outcomes:

- Define and explain the core principles; Compare & contrast linear and circular economic models.
- Identify strategies for waste reduction, resource recovery, and sustainable design.
- Analyze business models that support circular economy transitions.
- Evaluate the role of policy and regulation in advancing circular practices.
- Assess consumer behavior’s impact; Apply circular economy concepts to real-world case studies and industry trends.
- Develop actionable plans for implementing circular economy principles in businesses and communities.

Key Takeaways:

- Circular economy principles can drive environmental sustainability and economic resilience.
- Waste reduction, resource recovery, and sustainable design are fundamental to circularity.
- Businesses can benefit from innovative models such as Product-as-a
- Service and closed-loop supply chains.
- Policy and regulatory frameworks play a crucial role in facilitating circular economy adoption.
- Consumer awareness and behavioral change are essential for widespread implementation.
- Emerging technologies, such as AI, IoT, and blockchain, enhance circular practices.
- Urban development strategies can integrate circular economy principles for sustainable cities.

This audiobook is designed to provide a structured, engaging approach to understanding and applying circular economy principles in industries, policy, and community initiatives.

Eligible for CPD/PDU's (Continuing Professional Development / Professional Development Unit).

Summary from the publisher.

# My Buddy Bali

*A Tourist in Kisses and Tears*

- Written by: Leu Seyer
- Narrated by: Brian Dominguez
- Genre: Science fiction
- Length: 4 hr 35 min
- Released: April 22, 2025
- Publisher: Miguel A. Reyes-Mariano
- Language: English, unabridged
- Listen: [Audible](https://www.audible.com/pd/B0F5RH8P6P), [Apple Books](https://books.apple.com/us/audiobook/my-buddy-bali-a-tourist-in-kisses-and-tears-unabridged/id1809950600), [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0F5RLXG8G)
- Sample: https://samples.audible.com/bk/acx0/444843/bk_acx0_444843_sample.mp3

## About the book

In 2051, a seven-month-old Corgi named Bali, full of liveliness, ran away from his residence in Toronto, Canada, in a quest for freedom and ventures. He fell into the hands of two young pickpockets who planned to steal small valuables in Toronto and resell them in New York City. In his run-off, Bali constantly faces adversities created by inconsequential human activities, the so-called progress. He clashed with Climate change and the uncoordinated advances in new modes of flying transportation. During his journey, he stumbled into the house of genius scientists. Unbeknownst to him, their experimental device teleported him to the closest parallel dimension. During teleportation, an artificial intelligence microchip unintentionally left inside the apparatus merged animal and machine intelligence into one living being. This helped manage his landing in the soap opera the scientist’s son's girlfriend was watching on television. The episode was a rerun of the award-winning South Korean melodrama "Kisses and Tears" from 2042.

Summary from the publisher.

# The Disavowed

Espionage thriller series by Tobey Alvarez. Books 1 to 4 are audiobooks narrated by Brian Dominguez, 14 hr 27 min in all.

- [The Disavowed: The Ninth Division](https://briandominguezvoice.com/audiobooks/the-disavowed-the-ninth-division/index.md): by Tobey Alvarez; espionage thriller, book 1 of The Disavowed; 4 hr 12 min; released January 27, 2026
- [The Disavowed: The Tribunal's Shadow](https://briandominguezvoice.com/audiobooks/the-disavowed-the-tribunals-shadow/index.md): by Tobey Alvarez; espionage thriller, book 2 of The Disavowed; 4 hr; released March 25, 2026
- [The Disavowed: Project Vanguard](https://briandominguezvoice.com/audiobooks/the-disavowed-project-vanguard/index.md): by Tobey Alvarez; espionage thriller, book 3 of The Disavowed; 2 hr 59 min; released August 10, 2026
- [The Disavowed: Project Null](https://briandominguezvoice.com/audiobooks/the-disavowed-project-null/index.md): by Tobey Alvarez; espionage thriller, book 4 of The Disavowed; 3 hr 16 min; released October 10, 2026

---

# Narration for authors

Brian Dominguez narrates for independent authors through ACX, Audible's marketplace for audiobook production.

- Fiction: 6 titles, including all 4 books of The Disavowed
- Nonfiction: 8 titles: business, fatherhood, personal finance, psychology, relationships, self-help and travel
